description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ParserModifySubPanel' that extends 'ParserModifyListView' to handle modifications of subpanel definitions in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for initializing subpanel configurations, retrieving default and available fields, getting field details, and saving modifications implemented via the user interface.

classes.name: ParserModifySubPanel
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to modify and save subpanel display configurations within SuiteCRM, including retrieving available/suggested fields and handling save operations.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the parser with module and subpanel names, loads subpanel definitions, and prepares data structures for modification.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Returns the default list of fields currently configured for display in the subpanel.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available fields from the parent module that can be added to the subpanel.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific field by name from the current or original list definitions.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes and saves the user's modifications to the subpanel's field layout.
